ana: Quick follow-up on INC-2026 postmortem — we need a short, actionable runbook page for the recurring KV cache eviction spikes. Single thread for owners/timelines.

kevin: I'll own the triage checklist and minimal commands. Plan: PR with the one-pager by Thursday.

marta: I'll own escalation/PagerDuty entries and the 3-step ladder (oncall -> infra lead -> ops lead). Will draft PD messages by Wednesday.

sre-bot: [incident-bot] Postmortem linked: https://pm.redwood/internal/inc-2026 — owners: kevin (triage), marta (escalation).

ana: For triage, include these quick checks and safety flags. Keep decision rule concise (per-customer throttle vs global evict).

kevin: Draft triage snippet to include in PR:```bash
# show recent eviction events (last 10m)
rictl logs svc/inference --since 10m | jq 'select(.event=="kv_evict")' | tail -n 30
# check shard hit ratio
redwood-metrics query 'kv_cache_hit_ratio{shard="inference"}' --last 5m
# dry-run manual eviction
rictl exec svc/inference --force-kv-evict --shard=inference --dry-run
# commit manual eviction
rictl exec svc/inference --force-kv-evict --shard=inference --confirm
```

marta: Add decision rule: if >70% of evictions correlate to one api_key -> throttle that key first and notify CS with template; otherwise run global eviction + start canary rotate. I'll add PD escalation timings (10m check, 25m infra lead, 40m ops lead).

kevin: I'll include a one-line rollback command for recent model deploys since we saw deploy correlation. Also adding link to GH issue that will track these tasks.

marta: I'll request security review for PD message content. PD entries will include quick links to the playbook and the postmortem.

ana: Timeline recap: kevin PR by Thu, marta PD entries by Wed, GH issue created today to track checklists. I'll check in next Monday to confirm merge/publish. If anything slips, call it out here to reassign. :white_check_mark:
